build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable number of experts and MOLE dropout for molecular ML
merge_escnmd_moe_backbone: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MOLE layers into a single Linear layer for single-dataset inference optimization
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper to route predictions through dataset-specific expert heads using MOLE layers
create_dataset_specific_single_head_wrap: create a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper to share a single head across multiple datasets with named output routing
review_mole_coefficient_routing: review the set_MOLE_coefficients method that computes expert mixing coefficients from composition and CSD embeddings
